MedicalJobsAustralia.com     In this full-time role, based in Richmond, the Applications Support Analyst is responsible for the execution of activities required to support and maintain applications within the Application portfolio, of the Digital and Technology division of Epworth Healthcare.

The Applications Support Analyst is part of a larger team providing support for all cloud and on prem applications ensuring they work as designed, are maintained and available as required.

The Applications Support Analyst is responsible for the day to day execution of assigned tasks required for providing support, upkeep and maintenance of the application portfolio in line with agreed and implemented best practices and service levels. 

You will make an impact by:

Providing ongoing maintenance of the Epworth application portfolio, including all support required for the successful operation of applications to meet service expectations.

Engagement of the Epworth applications management practices, processes and systems to improve the delivery of the application portfolio to meet the client satisfaction KPI's.

The triage of all escalated Incidents, request for change, problems, errors and service requests. The undertaking of addressing with the view to restore service of all assigned support calls.

Providing an acceptable workaround to the Epworth users in a prompt fashion if a resolution is not readily available.

Assist with the implementation and-or upgrade of systems

Ensure that integrations are monitored, functioning correctly and issues are resolved or escalated where required.

To be successful in this role.

You will be someone with experience in delivering and managing cloud technologies and a willingness to bring innovative ideas, new approaches to existing practices and a diverse mindset to the team.

You will have:

Knowledge in application development and-or technical support

Knowledge in application architectures with technical and functional experience with enterprise level application portfolios, including working with COTS, SaaS, delivered solutions.

Demonstrated understanding in implementing software applications including software packaging, configuration and scripting in a Hybrid environment

Knowledge of middleware and integration technologies.

Strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

2+ years IT industry with experience in delivery, software support and-or development

Tertiary qualifications in a relevant discipline and or equivalent mix of education and relevant experience within application development and-or support

Extensive information systems and supervisory management experience in a complex organisation, preferably within the Health Sector or similar

ITIL qualifications with service management experience in an operational environment, desirable

Certifications in relevant field, desirable

Location: Derby, Western Australia (West Kimberley)
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing (38 hours per week)

Salary: $69,000 – $72,000 per annum plus superannuation, with the final salary determined by qualifications and relevant experience.

About Us

Coral Coast Distributors (Cairns) Pty Ltd is a privately owned retail and distribution business servicing regional and remote communities throughout the Kimberley region of Western Australia.

Our operations support retail stores and distribution activities that provide household goods and everyday essentials to regional communities. We are committed to delivering excellent customer service while maintaining efficient and compliant business operations.

The Role

We are seeking a motivated and organised General Clerk to provide administrative and clerical support to our Derby operations.

This full-time position is responsible for a broad range of office administration duties and provides support to management and operational teams across the business. The successful applicant will be highly organised, accurate and capable of managing multiple priorities within a busy office environment.

Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities
Perform a broad range of administrative and clerical duties.
Maintain accurate records, filing systems and business documentation.
Enter and maintain data within internal business systems.
Prepare correspondence, reports and routine business documents.
Assist with invoicing, purchase orders and general office administration.
Support payroll processing, timesheet administration and employee records.
Respond to telephone, email and general office enquiries.
Maintain supplier, customer and inventory records.
Schedule meetings, appointments and other administrative activities as required.
Use Microsoft Office and internal business systems to support daily operations.
Provide administrative support to managers and operational staff.
Skills and Experience
Previous experience in an administrative, clerical or office support role.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
Strong organisational and time-management skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately.
Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers.

Willingness to live and work in Derby, a regional location in the West Kimberley.
Desirable
Certificate III or IV in Business Administration or a related qualification.
